decision_conditions: Condition 10 (Use Class Restriction for Commercial) of planning permission reference 77460/APP/2023/2671, dated 09-01-24, is amended to:

The hereby approved Class E Commercial Space, as specified on drawing number CBA-1039-PL100 Proposed Plans Rev H, shall be used only for purposes within Use Class E(a) (display or retail sale of goods, other than hot food) and Use Class E(c) (financial services, professional services or other appropriate services in a commercial, business or service locality) of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), and for no other purpose (including any other purpose within Class E).
In the interests of maintaining the amenities of neighbouring residents in accordance with Policy DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 2 - Development Management Policies (2020).
Condition 11 (Operating and Delivery hours) of planning permission reference 77460/APP/2023/2671, dated 09-01-24, is amended to:

The hereby approved Class E(a) & Class E(c) Use as specified on drawing number CBA - 1039 - PL100 Proposed Plans_Rev H shall not be open to visiting members of the public and shall not receive deliveries, except between the hours of 08.00am and 23.00pm hours on Mondays to Saturdays and between the hours of 09.00am to 19.00pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays.

To safeguard the residential amenity of the occupiers of adjoining and nearby properties in accordance with Policy DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020).
Condition 12 (Delivery and Servicing Management Plan) of planning permission reference 77460/APP/2023/2671, dated 09-01-24, is amended to:

Prior to first occupation of the Class E(a) & Class E(c) Use hereby approved, a Delivery and Servicing Management Plan detailing how the retail use within the development is to be serviced shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the approved Delivery and Servicing Management Plan shall be implemented and shall remain for as long as the development is occupied.

To safeguard the amenity of surrounding areas and in the interest of highway safety in accordance with Policies DMHB 11, DMT 1 and DMT 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020) and Policy T4 of the London Plan (2021).

Notwithstanding the non-material amendments hereby approved, other than Conditions 10, 11 and 12, which is superseded by the above conditions, all other conditions relating to planning permission reference 77460/APP/2023/2671, dated 09-01-24, must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 77460/APP/2023/2671, dated 09-01-24 (Replacement of vacant car sales centre with a 3-storey mixed use development comprising of 1 x 1-bed apartment, 7 x 2-bed apartments and 1 x 3-bed apartment, with associated ground floor undercroft car and cycle parking and ground floor commercial space (Use Class E)) to allow for another use within Class E(a) and Class E(c) to let the unit.
